content:
info:
    name: springboot heapdump检测是否泄露
    author: Harry
    severity: high
    description: |
    metadata:
        FOFA:icon_hash="116323821"

http:
  - raw:
    - |
        GET /actuator/ HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
            - 'status_code == 200'
            - 'contains(body, "heapdump")'
        condition: and
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
author: &#31909
